description: Generation and Load Profile Type 10kV-400V Network is a data set deposited in DTU Data by its authors Aeishwarya Umesh Baviskar, Kaushik Das. This folder contains '.csv' files. The files contain the type of load and generator connected to each of the 10 kV or 400 V nodes in the network . Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 359510 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
